- The past was often brutal (child labor, widespread slavery, limited rights)

- Immediate exposure to news creates false impression of increase

**Selection bias:** We may only remember the "good" parts of previous eras

- Different regions/countries show different trends
- Structural changes (technology, urbanization) affect measurability

- Media distortion rather than reality
- Cognitive biases favoring nostalgic views
- Conflation of visibility with actual prevalence
- Difficulty defining and measuring morality objectively
